make_kong: This is a game of mahjong: draw, hold and set your tiles as a mahjong player would, following the usual mahjong conventions. How the opponent plays: its only move is to discard one of its tiles by knocking it over with its arm; this move starts with the episode, and its arm moves only while your own commands advance the simulation.

play_tic_tac_toe: The board is fixed in place and cannot be moved by the robot. How the opponent plays: whenever the cells hold exactly one more of your pieces than of the opponent's and both your arms are back near their initial poses, the opponent starts placing its next piece on a randomly chosen free cell; its arm moves only while your own commands advance the simulation.
